results.title: Getting Started - Jasmine Documentation
results.snippet: Jasmine is a Behavior Driven Development (BDD) testing framework for JavaScript. No external dependencies required. Built-in matchers and spies.

results.title: jasmine - npm
results.snippet: Jasmine has around 2.5M weekly downloads. Declining from peak popularity; many teams migrated to Jest. Still used in Angular projects.

results.title: jasmine/jasmine: Simple JavaScript testing framework - GitHub
results.snippet: Jasmine: DOM-less simple JavaScript testing framework. 15k GitHub stars. Slower release cadence in recent years.

results.title: Is Jasmine still worth using in 2024?
results.snippet: Jasmine was groundbreaking in the BDD testing space but has largely been replaced by Jest and Vitest for new projects. Angular CLI still defaults to Jasmine.
